close_reason: Resolved by JMAP-ic0j.1: MemoryError reshaped from pub struct MemoryError(pub String) to #[non_exhaustive] named-field with pub fn new()/description(). The SemVer-lock-in concern this bead flags is now closed — the new shape can grow fields without a break.
description:
Related to but distinct from JMAP-ic0j.1: memory.rs:80 declares 'pub struct MemoryError(pub String)'. Once this crate is published to crates.io with this shape, any third-party consumer who does

  if let BackendSetError::Other(MemoryError(msg)) = err { ... }

will depend on the tuple-struct shape. Adding a field, switching to a named-field struct, or making the field private becomes a SemVer break.

The canonical mail-server shape (#[non_exhaustive], named-field, pub fn new()/description()) was specifically designed to avoid this exact lock-in (mail-server commit 2941c50).

This compounds JMAP-ic0j.1 (canonical-template divergence) with concrete consumer-API risk: the same change is also future-proofing.

Action: fix together with JMAP-ic0j.1, but worth tracking separately because the maintenance consequence (SemVer break) is the larger concern even if the canonical-template rule did not exist.

P2 — published-API design concern, not a present-day bug.
title: MemoryBackend: pub-field MemoryError exposes internals as part of public API
